new.name: AI Calculators
new.description: AI Calculators is a free set of 26 client-side calculators for teams running AI in production: estimate LLM API spend and compare model pricing, prompt caching, token counts, context windows, RAG chunking and embedding budgets, vision image tokens, agent cost per task, voice-agent cost per minute, model routing and LLM VRAM sizing. Everything runs in your browser.

new.name: Imagera Code
new.description: Imagera Code is a terminal AI coding agent (npm i -g imagera-code) that gives you Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and hundreds of other models on one plan, switchable mid-chat with /models. It uses a single weekly limit instead of short lockouts, lets you keep going on credits past the limit, and says it keeps none of your code; plans start at $20 a month.

new.name: Imagera Studio
new.description: Imagera is an AI creative studio that brings image, video, voice and music generation and editing models into one workspace for product photography, marketing and client work, with side-by-side model pricing and a pay-as-you-go API. Plans start at $19.99 a month for 380 credits, with one-time credit packs also available.

new.name: DisconfirmAI
new.description: DisconfirmAI is a reading and research workspace for people following AI companies and industry change. Its public Reading page offers dated AI-assisted briefs with links to the source material, readable without an account, alongside an AI investment index, AI 100, industry map and AI ETF views in eight languages; personal research and long-term watches need sign-in and credits. It gives no buy or sell signals.

new.name: OpenStays
new.description: OpenStays is an AI booking engine for Indian homestays, hotels and resorts: it takes direct bookings, manages availability and guest payments, handles WhatsApp reservations, and uses a conversational assistant to answer routine guest enquiries and follow-ups. It also manages guest ID records and is preparing properties for guests who book through AI agents.

new.name: CREW Ai by FlightAtom
new.description: CREW Ai is FlightAtom's AI module for airlines and aircraft operators that optimises crew rosters and helps recover from disruptions. It is one module of FlightAtom's aviation platform, which also covers safety management, investigations, flight data monitoring, manuals and operations analytics; pricing is by demo and quote.

new.name: Videoify
new.description: Videoify is an image-to-video AI generator: upload a still, describe the motion, optionally add an end frame to control where the shot lands, and export a 1 to 30 second clip up to 2K with synced audio and no watermark. It offers MiniMax, Seedance 2.5 and Wan 3.0 models, with monthly plans from $9.99.

new.name: Kinovi
new.description: Kinovi is one pay-as-you-go API for running hosted video, image and audio generation models such as Seedance 2.5, Wan 3.0 and other provider models, with clear model IDs, per-second rates and docs with examples. The same credit balance also works in the Kinovi Studio web app if you would rather generate without code.

stars.name: REA
stars.description: MCP server and CLI that lets coding agents reverse engineer native binaries, Electron and JavaScript apps, .NET assemblies and live websites, using Ghidra, Hopper or IDA under the hood.

stars.name: OpenClaw
stars.description: OpenClaw is an MIT-licensed personal AI assistant that runs on your own computer and answers in the chat apps you already use, including Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram and WhatsApp, with native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows and Linux. State, memory and credentials stay on your hardware, models and harnesses such as Claude, Codex or local models are swappable plugins, and one gateway can run a personal or shared multiplayer assistant. It is stewarded by the non-profit OpenClaw Foundation with no paid tier or hosted service.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); you pay only for the model providers you connect.

stars.name: ECC
stars.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond

stars.name: DeepSeek Harness
stars.description: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness with a local web UI, built so that every tool, model and scheduled task is a swappable plugin; still a developer preview.

stars.name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
stars.description: Hermes Agent is Nous Research's MIT-licensed, self-improving agent with a built-in learning loop: it writes skills from completed tasks, refines them in use, keeps agent-curated memory and searches its own past conversations. It runs on anything from a $5 VPS to serverless infrastructure, offers a full terminal UI, and one gateway serves Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal and the CLI, with any model via Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or your own endpoint.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); model usage billed by your chosen provider.

stars.name: opencode
stars.description: OpenCode is an MIT-licensed open-source AI coding agent for the terminal, with a beta desktop app, that works with many model providers instead of locking you to one. Install it with a one-line script, npm, Homebrew, pacman, mise or Nix, then let it read your repository, edit files and run commands from a keyboard-driven TUI.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); bring your own model provider.

stars.name: n8n
stars.description: Workflow automation with AI agent nodes; self-host or cloud.

stars.name: Firecrawl
stars.description: Turns websites into clean, LLM-ready data for agents.
